title: A Waiver with a Date
story: Lila's invoice for the menu drawings had sat unpaid for six weeks. The contract allowed a late fee after thirty days, as a small share of the balance, and it allowed her to pause new work. Farid wrote that a kitchen refit had emptied the week's takings and asked for time. Lila still wanted the autumn menu, so she did not add the fee. She set the balance due within ten days, warned that the fee would follow if that date slipped, and refused to start the autumn drawings until the invoice was cleared. The waiver was limited and written down. His letter explained the gap, but it did not erase the debt. Farid paid on the ninth day. Lila kept the exchange, because a friendly concession without a date would have been difficult to rely on later.

The amount of money still owed.
Fully paid, so nothing remains owed.

quiz.question: How soon did Lila require the unpaid balance to be paid?
options: Within ten days
After another six weeks
When the autumn menu was printed
When the kitchen refit ended
quiz.explanation: She set the balance due within ten days.
quiz.supportingSentence: She set the balance due within ten days, warned that the fee would follow if that date slipped, and refused to start the autumn drawings until the invoice was cleared.

quiz.question: When did Farid actually pay the invoice?
options: On the ninth day
On the day the bill was first written
Six weeks after the new deadline
After the autumn drawings were delivered
quiz.explanation: Farid paid on the ninth day.
quiz.supportingSentence: Farid paid on the ninth day.

quiz.question: Why does Lila keep the written exchange?
options: An undated kindness would be hard to depend on later
Farid had asked her to draw a second cafe
The late fee could be settled only in coins
The kitchen refit had ended the contract
quiz.correctAnswer: An undated kindness would be hard to depend on later
quiz.explanation: She keeps the exchange because a friendly concession without a date would be difficult to rely on later.
quiz.supportingSentence: Lila kept the exchange, because a friendly concession without a date would have been difficult to rely on later.

quiz.question: What does waiver mean in this passage?
options: A choice not to apply a fee the contract allowed
A new kitchen finished before autumn
A drawing of the dishes on the menu
Money that arrived on the ninth day
quiz.correctAnswer: A choice not to apply a fee the contract allowed
quiz.explanation: The contract allowed a late fee, and her decision not to add it is the limited waiver she wrote down.
quiz.supportingSentence: The waiver was limited and written down.

quiz.question: Why does the writer mention the kitchen refit?
options: To give Farid's reason for needing more time
To show that Lila designed the new kitchen
To prove the menu drawings were never delivered
To argue that cafes should stop serving food
quiz.correctAnswer: To give Farid's reason for needing more time
quiz.explanation: Farid writes that the refit emptied the week's takings, which is why he asks for time.
quiz.supportingSentence: Farid wrote that a kitchen refit had emptied the week's takings and asked for time.
